subject: Post-discovery: Book evaluation kickoff + finalize success measures
messages:
From: markus.klein@redwood.inference
To: aisha.patel@brightlinehealth.com, patrick.dunne@brightlinehealth.com
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.inference, ben.carter@redwood.inference
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery: Book evaluation kickoff + finalize success measures

Hi Aisha / Patrick —

Thanks again for a productive discovery this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Goal: validate Redwood for enterprise clinical summarization and secure throughput/latency targets for triage workflows.
- Key success measures you mentioned: 90% recall on chief-complaint extraction, <150ms median token latency for short summaries, and no PHI retention beyond session.
- What we propose next: a technical deep dive + eval kickoff where we walk through the trial charter, agree on success criteria, and hand off a short prompt set for the first run.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed Dec 2, 10:00–11:00am
- Thu Dec 3, 1:30–2:30pm
- Fri Dec 4, 11:00–11:45am (shorter)

Attached is a one-page trial charter draft and a short prompt-guidelines doc that outlines how we'll structure the prompt pack and evals. Can you confirm which slot works and whether your engineering lead (or someone from clinical informatics) should join?

If none of the above work, share 2 windows that do and I’ll send an invite. Once we lock a time I’ll share a calendar invite + a short pre-kickoff checklist (data samples, test accounts, and the prompt template).

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

— Markus Klein
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.inference
Redwood Inference

Attachments: trial-charter-draft.pdf (1 page), prompt-pack-guidelines.docx (docx)

From: aisha.patel@brightlinehealth.com
To: markus.klein@redwood.inference
Cc: patrick.dunne@brightlinehealth.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: Book evaluation kickoff + finalize success measures

Markus —

Appreciate the clear recap. Wed Dec 2 at 10:00am PT works for Patrick and me; I’ll add Dr. Lee from clinical informatics if he’s available.

A couple quick asks before the kickoff so we come prepared:
- Can you confirm the exact data formats you’ll accept for the initial prompt pack (FHIR JSON, CSV export, or both)?
- For success metrics, could you add precision for entity extraction (not just recall) and suggest a default evaluation window (we were thinking 48–72 hours of representative notes)?

I took a look at the charter — looks good. Please send the calendar invite and the pre-kickoff checklist. We’ll aim to have a small sample (de-identified) dataset ready before the call.

Thanks — Aisha
Aisha Patel
Senior PM, Clinical Integrations
Brightline Health
aisha.patel@brightlinehealth.com

Subject: Fwd: Post-discovery: Book evaluation kickoff + finalize success measures

Folks — forwarding the Brightline thread. They confirmed Wed Dec 2 at 10:00am PT for the kickoff and asked for details on accepted data formats and a suggested evaluation window. Can you help with the following before I send the final invite?

Action items:
- Neha: can you prepare a sample prompt pack (3–5 templates) and a short note on evaluation windows (recommended 48–72h vs 7-day) plus precision/recall guidance for entity extraction? Please include a small anonymized example (FHIR JSON snippet) we can ask Brightline to provide.
- Ben: can you confirm whether we can provision a test tenant with logging/audit enabled for them by Dec 2 and whether we need an NDA amendment for PHI-simulated data?

I’ve attached the draft charter and guidelines for context. If you can turn around by EOD today I’ll send the calendar invite and prep checklist to Brightline.

Thanks — Markus

Forwarded attachments: trial-charter-draft.pdf, prompt-pack-guidelines.docx

From: neha.kapoor@redwood.inference
To: markus.klein@redwood.inference, ben.carter@redwood.inference
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-discovery: Book evaluation kickoff + finalize success measures

Markus / Ben —

I’ll prepare the prompt pack and a brief eval note by 4:30pm PT. Plan:

- Prompt pack: 5 templates (chief complaint extraction, short summary, triage priority, meds reconciliation, redaction check). I’ll include one de-identified FHIR JSON snippet (anonymized fields) and a CSV example.
- Evaluation guidance: suggest 72-hour window as default, include both precision and recall targets per entity (suggested baseline: recall 0.90 / precision 0.85 for chief-complaint; adapt per entity).
- Deliverables: prompt-pack-v1.zip (stub), short README with scoring script pointers, Drive folder link.

Ben — can you confirm test tenant availability & logging? If provisioned today we can include the access steps in the invite.

I’ll upload the artifacts to the Drive link and send the calendar invite once you confirm Ben’s check.

— Neha
Senior ML Ops, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.inference

Attachments uploaded: prompt-pack-v1.zip (stub)
